question: which branch has the most out of stock items
normalised: which branch most out stock items
sql:
WITH branch_counts AS (
    SELECT v.branch,
           COUNT(*) AS out_of_stock_item_count
    FROM v_out_of_stock_by_branch v
    GROUP BY v.branch
)
SELECT b.branch,
       b.out_of_stock_item_count,
       COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY b.out_of_stock_item_count) AS tie_count
FROM branch_counts b
ORDER BY b.out_of_stock_item_count DESC, b.branch

question: show me complete resin items details
sql:
WITH resin_item_master AS (
    SELECT
        i.item_code,
        i.name,
        i.default_specification,
        i.default_unit_of_measurement,
        i.category,
        i.is_active,
        i.is_verified
    FROM items i
    WHERE i.name ~* '[[:<:]]resins?[[:>:]]'
), resin_import_lines AS (
    SELECT
        ci.item_code,
        ci.item_name,
        ci.specification,
        ci.unit_of_measurement,
        c.current_status,
        c.origin
    FROM consignments c
    JOIN consignment_items ci
      ON ci.consignment_id = c.id
     AND ci.is_deleted = false
    WHERE c.is_deleted = false
      AND ci.item_name ~* '[[:<:]]resins?[[:>:]]'
), resin_export_lines AS (
    SELECT
        li.job_no AS item_code,
        li.item_detail AS item_name,
        NULL::text AS specification,
        NULL::text AS unit_of_measurement,
        lc.current_status,
        lc.origin_country AS origin
    FROM logistics_consignments lc
    JOIN logistics_items li
      ON li.consignment_id = lc.id
     AND li.is_deleted = false
    WHERE lc.is_deleted = false
      AND li.item_detail ~* '[[:<:]]resins?[[:>:]]'
), resin_trucking_records AS (
    SELECT
        NULL::text AS item_code,
        tc.item_details AS item_name,
        NULL::text AS specification,
        NULL::text AS unit_of_measurement,
        tc.movement_type AS current_status,
        NULL::text AS origin
    FROM trucking_consignments tc
    WHERE tc.is_deleted = false
      AND tc.item_details ~* '[[:<:]]resins?[[:>:]]'
)
SELECT
    'Item master' AS source,
    rim.item_code,
    rim.name AS item_name,
    rim.default_specification AS specification,
    rim.default_unit_of_measurement AS uom,
    rim.category,
    rim.is_active,
    rim.is_verified,
    NULL::text AS current_status,
    NULL::text AS origin
FROM resin_item_master rim
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'Import line' AS source,
    ril.item_code,
    ril.item_name,
    ril.specification,
    ril.unit_of_measurement AS uom,
    NULL::text AS category,
    NULL::boolean AS is_active,
    NULL::boolean AS is_verified,
    ril.current_status,
    ril.origin
FROM resin_import_lines ril
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'Export line' AS source,
    rel.item_code,
    rel.item_name,
    rel.specification,
    rel.unit_of_measurement AS uom,
    NULL::text AS category,
    NULL::boolean AS is_active,
    NULL::boolean AS is_verified,
    rel.current_status,
    rel.origin
FROM resin_export_lines rel
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'Trucking record' AS source,
    rtr.item_code,
    rtr.item_name,
    rtr.specification,
    rtr.unit_of_measurement AS uom,
    NULL::text AS category,
    NULL::boolean AS is_active,
    NULL::boolean AS is_verified,
    rtr.current_status,
    rtr.origin
FROM resin_trucking_records rtr
ORDER BY source, item_name, item_code

question: who is our top supplier by value
sql:
WITH supplier_value_rows AS (
    SELECT
        p.supplier AS supplier_name,
        SUM(p.amount) AS local_value,
        0::numeric AS import_value,
        COUNT(*) AS local_purchase_lines,
        0::bigint AS import_consignments,
        COUNT(p.amount) AS valued_records
    FROM purchases_data p
    GROUP BY p.supplier
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        s.name AS supplier_name,
        0::numeric AS local_value,
        SUM(c.pkr_total) AS import_value,
        0::bigint AS local_purchase_lines,
        COUNT(*) AS import_consignments,
        COUNT(c.pkr_total) AS valued_records
    FROM consignments c
    LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = c.supplier_id
    WHERE c.is_deleted = false
    GROUP BY s.name
), combined_suppliers AS (
    SELECT
        LOWER(TRIM(svr.supplier_name)) AS supplier_key,
        MIN(svr.supplier_name) AS supplier_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(svr.local_value), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(svr.import_value), 0) AS total_procurement_value,
        SUM(svr.local_purchase_lines) AS local_purchase_lines,
        SUM(svr.import_consignments) AS import_consignments,
        SUM(svr.valued_records) AS valued_records
    FROM supplier_value_rows svr
    GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(svr.supplier_name))
)
SELECT
    cs.supplier_name,
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(cs.supplier_name)) = 'import (iol)' THEN 'Import channel'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(cs.supplier_name)) = 'qadbros engineering pvt ltd' THEN 'Inter-company supplier'
        ELSE 'External supplier'
    END AS supplier_type,
    cs.total_procurement_value,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.total_procurement_value) AS tie_count,
    cs.local_purchase_lines,
    cs.import_consignments,
    cs.valued_records
FROM combined_suppliers cs
ORDER BY cs.total_procurement_value DESC NULLS LAST, cs.supplier_name NULLS LAST

question: top 3 suppliers
sql:
WITH supplier_spend_rows AS (
    SELECT
        lower(trim(p.supplier)) AS supplier_key,
        trim(p.supplier) AS supplier_name,
        p.amount AS spend_amount
    FROM purchases_data p
    WHERE p.supplier IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        lower(trim(s.name)) AS supplier_key,
        trim(s.name) AS supplier_name,
        c.pkr_total AS spend_amount
    FROM consignments c
    LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = c.supplier_id
    WHERE c.is_deleted = false
      AND s.name IS NOT NULL
), supplier_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ssr.supplier_key,
        min(ssr.supplier_name) AS supplier_name,
        coalesce(sum(ssr.spend_amount), 0) AS total_spend_pkr,
        count(*) AS purchase_records,
        count(ssr.spend_amount) AS valued_purchase_records
    FROM supplier_spend_rows ssr
    GROUP BY ssr.supplier_key
)
SELECT
    st.supplier_name,
    st.total_spend_pkr,
    st.purchase_records,
    st.valued_purchase_records,
    CASE
        WHEN st.supplier_key = 'import (iol)' THEN 'Import channel, not a company'
        WHEN st.supplier_key = 'qadbros engineering pvt ltd' THEN 'Group company / inter-company transfer'
        ELSE 'Supplier'
    END AS supplier_type,
    count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY st.total_spend_pkr) AS tie_count
FROM supplier_totals st
ORDER BY st.total_spend_pkr DESC NULLS LAST, st.supplier_name
LIMIT 3

question: Both combined
sql:
WITH supplier_value_records AS (
    SELECT
        LOWER(TRIM(p.supplier)) AS supplier_key,
        p.supplier AS supplier_name,
        p.amount AS value_pkr
    FROM purchases_data p
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        LOWER(TRIM(s.name)) AS supplier_key,
        s.name AS supplier_name,
        c.pkr_total AS value_pkr
    FROM consignments c
    LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = c.supplier_id
    WHERE c.is_deleted = false
), supplier_totals AS (
    SELECT
        svr.supplier_key,
        MAX(svr.supplier_name) AS supplier_name,
        SUM(svr.value_pkr) AS total_value_pkr,
        COUNT(*) AS contributing_records,
        COUNT(svr.value_pkr) AS valued_records,
        MAX(svr.value_pkr) AS largest_single_record_value_pkr
    FROM supplier_value_records svr
    GROUP BY svr.supplier_key
), ranked_suppliers AS (
    SELECT
        st.supplier_name,
        st.total_value_pkr,
        st.contributing_records,
        st.valued_records,
        st.largest_single_record_value_pkr,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY st.total_value_pkr) AS tie_count
    FROM supplier_totals st
)
SELECT
    rs.supplier_name,
    rs.total_value_pkr,
    rs.contributing_records,
    rs.valued_records,
    rs.largest_single_record_value_pkr,
    rs.tie_count
FROM ranked_suppliers rs
ORDER BY rs.total_value_pkr DESC NULLS LAST, rs.supplier_name ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

question: top 5 suppliers by value in local purchases
normalised: top 5 suppliers by value local purchases
sql:
WITH supplier_totals AS (
    SELECT
        p.supplier AS supplier_name,
        COUNT(*) AS purchase_lines,
        SUM(p.amount) AS total_purchase_value,
        MAX(p.amount) AS largest_line_value
    FROM purchases_data p
    GROUP BY p.supplier
)
SELECT
    st.supplier_name,
    st.purchase_lines,
    st.total_purchase_value,
    st.largest_line_value,
    st.largest_line_value / NULLIF(st.total_purchase_value, 0) AS largest_line_share,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY st.total_purchase_value) AS tie_count
FROM supplier_totals st
ORDER BY st.total_purchase_value DESC NULLS LAST, st.supplier_name
LIMIT 5

question: what is the status of silica sand
sql:
WITH stock_position AS (
    SELECT
        s.item_code,
        COUNT(*) AS branches_held_at,
        SUM(s.stock_qty) AS stock_qty,
        SUM(s.hold_qty) AS hold_qty,
        SUM(s.available_qty) AS available_qty,
        SUM(s.available_amount) AS available_amount
    FROM stock s
    WHERE s.item_code IN ('23556-60', '2951-147')
    GROUP BY s.item_code
)
SELECT
    i.item_code,
    i.name AS item_name,
    i.default_unit_of_measurement AS uom,
    sp.branches_held_at,
    sp.stock_qty,
    sp.hold_qty,
    sp.available_qty,
    sp.available_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN sp.item_code IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE sp.available_qty <= 0
    END AS is_out_of_stock
FROM items i
LEFT JOIN stock_position sp ON sp.item_code = i.item_code
WHERE i.item_code IN ('23556-60', '2951-147')
ORDER BY i.item_code
